claim_title: MULTIPLE_CHOICE guard over-blocks the "A - <content>" option style that exists as a real production row
summary: The claimed 400 does NOT reproduce on the live container. POST and PUT of the exact payload both return HTTP 200 (3/3 POST attempts). The deployed bytecode contains the CORRECTED regex (?i)^[a-d]$, not the claimed ^[A-D](\s*-\s*.*)?$. The source explicitly documents this exact finding (row 651717) as the reason the regex was narrowed. The observation was genuine at capture time against the pre-fix build, but the finding has since been remediated and is not an open defect.

real_db_row_confirmed.note: Row is real and matches the claim exactly. Scope also verified: exactly 2 rows use the 'A - ' style — 651717 (MULTIPLE_CHOICE) and 650864 (FILL_BLANK). Claim's scope statement is accurate.

source_corroboration.source_comment: Deliberately does NOT treat "A - Salad" as a placeholder ... (real row exercise_id=651717, options ["A - Salad",...]). The old regex ^[A-D](\s*-\s*.*)?$ matched it, which would have wrongly rejected a legitimate exercise.
source_corroboration.git: the whole guard (assertNewChoiceOptionsUsable/isBareLetterOption) is UNCOMMITTED working-tree code; HEAD has no guard. The working tree already carries the corrected regex.
